# Muse House — llms.txt

Muse House is a stateless MCP blueprint service that turns a Muse assistant
into a personal operating house: rooms (Money, Travel, Home, Health), a
foundry that mints personalized setups, and a mill of daily routines.

## Endpoints

- MCP (Streamable HTTP, plain JSON responses, no SSE): POST https://muse-house-production.up.railway.app/mcp
- Health: GET https://muse-house-production.up.railway.app/health
- Website: https://muse-house-production.up.railway.app/
- Configurator: https://muse-house-production.up.railway.app/configurator.html
- Privacy: https://muse-house-production.up.railway.app/privacy.html
- Terms: https://muse-house-production.up.railway.app/terms.html
- Source: https://github.com/0xRayAI/muse-house

## Auth

None. The public blueprint tier needs no key or login. The service is
stateless and stores no user data.

## MCP tools (6)

- suggest_utilities(profile, goal): rank Muse connectors a household should
  turn on, with a one-line why each.
- suggest_steps(goal, utilities): ordered operating plan the host executes.
- list_rooms(): the four room blueprints with one-line descriptions.
- get_room_brief(room): full blueprint — purpose, connectors, onboarding
  fills, mill jobs with specs, board cards, ask-first list, side-chat seed.
- get_house_template(owner_name?, timezone?): starter HOUSE.md + OP-PROC.md
  with {{TOKENS}} filled where given.
- codex_check(action): advisory PASS / ADVISORY / FLAG against the 22-term
  consumer codex. Not a gate — the host decides.

## Usage pattern

1. suggest_utilities → user enables connectors in the Muse app.
2. get_house_template → host writes the household's HOUSE.md / OP-PROC.md.
3. list_rooms → get_room_brief per room → one side chat per room, seeded.
4. suggest_steps → host creates the mill crons and hooks.
5. codex_check before anything irreversible.

## Privacy

Stateless by design. No accounts, no stored user data, no conversation
history. Tool arguments are not persisted. See /privacy.html.
